problems.title: Anytime Regret with n Experts Matching Fixed-Horizon Constant
problems.statement: Design a horizon-oblivious algorithm for prediction with expert advice over n experts and bounded losses in [0,1]^n whose regret satisfies R_t <= (1 + o(1)) * sqrt(t * ln(n) / 2) simultaneously for all t >= 1.

directions.name: Geometric Grid + Active Window Retirement
directions.claim: Maintain O(eps^-1 log delta^-1) active MW instances on grid H^m = (1+eps)^m, waking at floor(delta * H^m) and retiring at floor(H^m).

directions.name: Time-Varying Learning Rate Single MW
directions.claim: Use a single MW instance with eta_t = sqrt(ln n / (2t)) without restarts.

attempts.method: Direct potential telescoping with eta_t = sqrt(ln n / (2t))
attempts.summary: Attempted to bound cumulative mixability gap directly via Abel summation.
attempts.draft_markdown:
### Draft R1-P1
Assume eta_t = sqrt(ln n / (2t)). By standard Hedge lemma, instantaneous regret is bounded by eta_t / 8 + KL divergence term. Summing over t yields sqrt(t ln n / 2) + O(sqrt(t)).
attempts.single_objection: KL divergence telescopes cleanly only when eta_t is non-increasing AND weights are not penalized by shifting reference distribution; missing factor of 2 in non-monotonic potential term.
attempts.comp_objection: Adversarial counterexample on n=2 shows non-restarted adaptive eta_t incurs strictly worse leading constant than sqrt(t ln n / 2) under oscillating loss switches.

attempts.method: Geometric horizon grid H^m = (1+eps)^m with master Hedge aggregation
attempts.summary: Combined fixed-horizon MW instances via master MW, waking at floor(delta H^m) and retiring after floor(H^m).
attempts.draft_markdown:
### Draft R2-P1
Let H^m = (1+eps)^m. Wake instance m at t_start = floor(delta H^m) and retire at floor(H^m). At most O(eps^-1 log delta^-1) instances are active simultaneously. Master Hedge tracks active pool with regret sqrt(t ln(pool_size)).
attempts.single_objection: Prefix [1, floor(delta H^m)) is uncovered when instance m wakes; the master must account for prior regret accumulated before t_start.
attempts.comp_objection: Birth of new instances requires redistributing probability mass from existing instances; mass-allocation tax is not bounded in Section 2.

attempts.method: Recursive prefix coverage + bounded mass-allocation tax on sleeping-expert master
attempts.summary: Covers prefix [1, floor(delta H^m)) recursively (geometric series 1 + sqrt(delta) + delta + ...) and bounds mass-allocation tax via eps = sqrt(ln ln n / ln n), delta = eps^3.
attempts.draft_markdown:
### Theorem (Anytime Regret Matching Fixed-Horizon Constant)
For any n >= 3 and any loss sequence in [0,1]^n, running geometric-grid MW instances H^m = (1+eps)^m woken at floor(delta H^m) and retired at floor(H^m) under a sleeping-experts master MW with eps = sqrt(ln ln n / ln n) and delta = eps^3 yields R_t <= (1 + O(sqrt(ln ln n / ln n))) * sqrt(t ln n / 2) for all t >= 1.

#### Proof
1. Active pool bound (Lemma L1): At any t, active m satisfy delta H^m <= t <= H^m, so at most ceil(log_{1+eps}(1/delta)) = O(eps^-1 log(1/delta)) instances are active.
2. Prefix recursion (Lemma L2): Uncovered prefix before floor(delta H^m) is covered by earlier grid scales, contributing geometric factor sum_{k>=0} delta^{k/2} = 1 + O(sqrt(delta)).
3. Mass-allocation tax: Each wake event shifts at most O(eps^2) mass; summing over O(eps^-1 log(1/delta)) births per lifetime adds O(sqrt(ln ln n / ln n)) relative overhead.
attempts.single_objection: All steps justified; boundary cases t < 1/delta and n -> infinity checked.
attempts.comp_objection: No shared blind spots; strictly stronger and cleaner than R3-P2.

ledger.title: L1: Bounded Active Instance Pool on Geometric Grid
ledger.statement: For H^m = (1+eps)^m with wake time floor(delta H^m) and retirement floor(H^m), at most O(eps^-1 ln(1/delta)) instances are active at any round t >= 1.
ledger.proof_sketch: If m is active at t, then delta (1+eps)^m <= t <= (1+eps)^m, hence m lies in [log_{1+eps}(t), log_{1+eps}(t/delta)], an interval of width ln(1/delta)/ln(1+eps) = O(eps^-1 ln(1/delta)).

ledger.title: L2: Geometric Prefix Recursion Bound
ledger.statement: Covering the pre-wake prefix [1, floor(delta H^m)) recursively across earlier grid blocks contributes at most a multiplicative factor 1 / (1 - sqrt(delta)) = 1 + O(sqrt(delta)).
ledger.proof_sketch: Each prior block ends at delta H^m, so its worst-case regret scales as sqrt(delta H^m ln n / 2). Summing the geometric series sum_{k>=0} delta^{k/2} converges to 1/(1 - sqrt(delta)).

ledger.title: D1: Non-restarted single MW with eta_t = sqrt(ln n / (2t))
ledger.statement: Excluded: cannot achieve leading constant 1/sqrt(2) without resets under adversarial oscillating losses.
ledger.proof_sketch: Verified counterexample constructed in Round 1 comparative audit.

advisor_notes.observation: Prover-1 omitted explicit handling of non-increasing learning-rate KL penalty terms.
advisor_notes.instruction_delta: Require all provers using time-varying learning rates to write the exact telescoping KL remainder term explicitly.

advisor_notes.observation: Both Round 2 drafts assumed newly woken experts start with zero prior regret without accounting for mass-allocation tax.
advisor_notes.instruction_delta: Mandate explicit accounting of probability-mass reallocation whenever new instances enter a master Hedge pool.

problems.title: Online Inverse Linear Optimization with O(d) Uniform Regret
problems.statement: Find a deterministic, proper, anytime algorithm for online inverse linear optimization in R^d achieving cumulative shortfall R_T = O(d) uniformly in T at O(d^2) arithmetic per round.

directions.name: Self-Normalized Variable Metric with tr(H_t^-1/2) Potential
directions.claim: Replace log det(H_t) potential (which leaks d ln T) with tr(H_t^-1/2) under self-normalized rank-one updates.

attempts.method: Rank-one metric update normalized by dual-metric norm s_t = ||g_t||_{H_t^-1}
attempts.summary: Showed tr(H_t^-1/2) starts at d and decreases by >= (tau/4) * s_t^2 per round.
attempts.draft_markdown:
### Draft ILO-R1
Let H_{t+1} = H_t + tau * (g_t g_t^T) / ||g_t||_{H_t^-1}^2. Using operator monotonicity of x -> -x^{-1/2}, we bound the trace drop per step.
attempts.single_objection: Step-size coupling alpha = Theta(1/d) verified; waiting for comparative check.

ledger.title: L1: Self-Normalized Trace-Power Potential Drop
ledger.statement: Under H_{t+1} = H_t + tau * u_t u_t^T with ||u_t||_{H_t^-1} = 1, tr(H_t^-1/2) - tr(H_{t+1}^-1/2) >= (tau/4) for tau <= 1/2.
ledger.proof_sketch: Follows from Sherman-Morrison inversion and concavity of t -> (1 + t)^(-1/2) on [0, 1/2].

advisor_notes.observation: Initial metric normalization constants were left implicit in early scratchpad.
advisor_notes.instruction_delta: State explicit constants for tau and alpha in terms of dimension d.
